trap.label: incontável plural
trap.wrong: The evidences suggest that teamwork is important.
trap.right: The evidence suggests that teamwork is important.
trap.why: Em português “as evidências” é plural contável. Em inglês, evidence é incontável: sem -s e com verbo no singular.

opts: restate the thesis in new words

mcq.q: This essay has ___ that teamwork matters.

fix.wrong: This essay has argue that it works.
fix.right: This essay has argued that it works.

fix.wrong: Taken together the data show it.
fix.right: Taken together, the data show it.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o present perfect: “This essay argues that it works.”
rewrite.answer: This essay has argued that it works.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no plural: “The evidence suggests this.” (The data…)
Use Taken together: “All arguments show it.”
rewrite.answer: Taken together, the arguments show it.
